title: Structured mild, moderate, and severe MDD generation

resolutionNote: CANMAT's source-cleared conventions section supplies one current, explicit severity scaffold: retain depressive symptom severity and depression-attributable functional impairment as separate dimensions and use the higher qualitative rating as the overall mild, moderate, or severe descriptor. It also demonstrates that the two dimensions may disagree. The source does not supply universal numeric boundaries. The source-cleared Mavranezouli review uses depression-scale cutoffs only to define less- and more-severe treatment-analysis populations, reinforcing that research strata are not diagnostic or generator thresholds. The preliminary adjunct search found no recent validation study that closes the remaining gap. Screening cutoffs, instrument bands, trial-entry thresholds, psychosis, safety, course, and treatment resistance therefore remain separate facts rather than silent severity proxies. Exact branch envelopes still require psychiatrist review; no generator profile, treatment rule, or point value is authorized.
